cases.decision: Eight occurrences in ID 26271 cite the 2007 IPCC chapter. One additional AR4 occurrence under ID 17259 cites the same chapter. They are distinct from the three Landauer et al. 2015 article occurrences, which retain ID 26271 and DOI 10.1007/s10584-015-1395-1.

The AR5 entry cites Brisley, Welstead, Hindle and Paavola (2012), a 118-page JRF report. The other three occurrences cite Shackleton et al. (2015), a Wiley article with a different author list, title and DOI.

The AR5 entry cites Tyler and Moench (2012), Climate and Development 4:311–326. The publisher confirms DOI 10.1080/17565529.2012.745389. The AR6 entry is Dhar and Khirfan (2017), Urban Climate 19:72–91. The original AR6 raw entry prints volume 17; preserve raw text. No exact Tyler DOI row exists in the local WoS table, so publisher DOI verification does not create a WoS match.

All three occurrences under ID 28347 cite Crutzen and Stoermer (2000), newsletter 41:17–18. The additional AR3 entry under ID 7174 gives those authors, year and newsletter number. Their identity recurrence is valid. Preferred metadata and the DOI/WoS bridge incorrectly describe Christmann (2024). Remove that bridge and restore the newsletter metadata. Retire empty ID 7174 only after its one occurrence is reassigned with an explicit crosswalk.

Both AR5 and AR6 entries cite Chiew and Prosser (2011), chapter Water and climate in Water: Science and Solutions for Australia, pp.29–46. The CSIRO publisher confirms chapter authors and book publication in November 2011. Their identity recurrence is valid. DOI 10.3390/w13060849 and the WoS record identify Koutsoyiannis (2021), a distinct single-author article.

The remaining raw entry is printed verbatim in the official AR4 WGIII chapter 11 references. The preferred 2019 encyclopedia DOI belongs to a different work. Preserve printed author initials; expansion of given names is not required for this repair.
